title: In conversation with Miguel Nicolelis
abstract: As part of our special issue on neurotechnology, we spoke with Miguel Nicolelis, Professor Emeritus at Duke University and founder of the Edmond and Lily Safra International Neuroscience Institute, about the bold ideas that have defined his career, from helping to pioneer brain–machine interfaces to establishing a neuroscience institute in northeastern Brazil with the goal of driving social transformation. He considers the scientific discoveries, technological hurdles and ethical questions that continue to shape the future of neural interfaces and neurorehabilitation.
abstract_zh: 作为我们神经技术专题的一部分，我们与杜克大学名誉教授、Edmond和Lily Safra国际神经科学研究所创始人Miguel Nicolelis进行了交谈，讨论了定义他职业生涯的大胆理念，从帮助开创脑机接口到在巴西东北部建立神经科学研究所，旨在推动社会转型。他探讨了继续塑造神经接口和神经康复未来的科学发现、技术挑战和伦理问题。
